cohort: 2873 infants born ≥35 weeks gestational age and admitted to the well-baby nursery between January and December 2017
finding: Using the AAP time-based definitional blood glucose cut-off values, the study found a lower incidence of hypoglycemia among infants screened for risk factors compared to other studies.
mod_finding: Infants screened for hypoglycemia and hypoglycemic infants had lower exclusive breastfeeding rates compared with those who were not screened or not hypoglycemic, respectively, and hypoglycemic infants were more likely to be born preterm and via C-section.
